cursorSpeedHelp: Cursor speed applied to Windows by this app. Default: maximum (20).
windowPositionSpeedHelp: Multiplier for window movement during a forced window drag (1-100). Independent of cursor speed. Default: 5.
keepWithinScreenHelp: When enabled, a window moved by set window position stops at the edge of the desktop. Moving between extended monitors still works.
diagnosticLogHelp: Enable or stop diagnostic log recording.
splitDiagnosticLogHelp: Off: all logs are written to logs\logs.jsonl. On: each program section writes to its own file in the logs folder, for example cursor-diagnostics.jsonl or clipboard-writer.jsonl.
fingerCountHelp: Number of fingers required to start a touchpad drag.
touchscreenFingerCountHelp: Number of fingers required to start a touchscreen drag. Three fingers are the default.
dragHoldDuration: Trigger hold duration to force a window drag (ms)
dragHoldDurationHelp: How long, in milliseconds (ms), a touchpad, touchscreen, mouse, or pen trigger must stay still before movement forces a window drag.
clickHoldForceWindowHelp: Hold the recorded mouse trigger still for the global hold duration, then move it to force a window drag.
dragButtonsHelp: Hold and move for a smart drag. Hold still for the global duration, then move to force a window drag.
primaryMouseButtonNotAllowed: The primary mouse button is reserved for normal clicks. Choose the secondary button or another mouse button.
flickDropHelp: A quick flick releases the dragged item.
flickVelocityHelp: Minimum movement, in pixels per polling interval, to release a drag with a flick.
releaseThresholdHelp: Finger movement distance, in pixels, before the cursor anchor releases for natural movement.
releaseSoundHelp: Play a sound when a drag is released.
cancelKeyHelp: Click Record and press a key. Press it during a drag to cancel. Clear disables it.
bringFrontHelp: Activate a window when you start dragging it.
hitTestHelp: Use Windows hit testing to identify targets.
cursorShapeHelp: Use cursor shape to recognize text and targets.
uiaHelp: Use Windows accessibility information to classify targets.
ocrDetectionHelp: Use OCR to recognize text under the cursor as an interactive target.
classNameHelp: Use Windows control classes as target hints.
solidColorDetectionHelp: Use pixel sampling to distinguish solid backgrounds from interactive elements.
emptyIBeamHelp: Allow window dragging from empty text areas.
iBeamAreaHelp: Width of the square checked around a text cursor, in pixels.
colorRectHelp: Side length of the square used for solid-color detection, in pixels.
ocrHelp: Recognize text under your finger with Windows OCR.
ocrHoldHelp: How long, in milliseconds (ms), to hold before text is captured.
ocrRadiusHelp: Maximum distance, in pixels, to search for text around the cursor.
ocrLanguageHelp: Choose an installed OCR language or use the Windows profile default.
ocrGapHelp: Maximum gap between words, as a percentage (%) of word height, for treating them as one line.
ocrClipboardHelp: Copy captured text to the clipboard.
ocrActivationDelayHelp: Wait after activating the target window before clicking the drop point.
ocrClickDelayHelp: Wait after clicking the drop point before pasting the captured text.
ocrClipboardRestoreDelayHelp: Wait after Ctrl+V before restoring the previous clipboard, so the target app can read the pasted text.
dragFallbackPollIntervalHelp: How often the drag engine checks the cursor as a fallback (ms).
windowDragSmoothingFrameHelp: Frame length used to smooth window movement (ms).
windowDragSmoothingMinTimeConstant: Window drag smoothing min time constant
windowDragSmoothingMaxTimeConstant: Window drag smoothing max time constant
windowDragSmoothingMaxElapsedHelp: Longest gap between updates that is still smoothed (ms).
settingsInputDebounceHelp: Delay after typing a number before it is applied (ms).
settingsStatIntervalHelp: How often the config file is checked for changes (ms).
notificationSafetyTimeoutHelp: Maximum time the tray balloon notification waits before its message loop is closed (ms).
notificationBalloonTimeoutHelp: How long the tray balloon notification is shown (ms).
settingsEventPollIntervalHelp: How often the settings app checks for a request to show its window (ms).
settingsCaptureRefreshIntervalHelp: How often the settings window refreshes the button capture state (ms).
mouseCancelDragPollIntervalHelp: How often the mouse drag checks whether the cancel key is pressed (ms).
touchCancelDragPollIntervalHelp: How often the touchpad drag checks whether the cancel key is pressed (ms).
touchStationaryDragDropHoldHelp: How long the finger must stay still before a drop is armed (ms).
touchDragDropAnchorGraceHelp: Grace period when the anchor finger moves slightly (ms).
touchFingerLiftGraceHelp: Time allowed after a finger lifts before the gesture ends (ms).
touchscreenCancelDragPollIntervalHelp: How often the touchscreen drag checks whether the cancel key is pressed (ms).
touchscreenContactLostGraceHelp: Time allowed after contact is lost before the drag ends (ms).
touchscreenRecentExternalCursorMovementH: How long external cursor movement still counts as recent (ms).
hitTestTimeoutHelp: Maximum wait for a window to answer a hit test (ms). Protects against hung apps.
uiAutomationClassifyTimeoutHelp: Maximum wait for UI Automation to classify an element (ms).
titleBarHitTestTimeoutHelp: Maximum wait for the title bar check (ms).
forcedDragModePollIntervalHelp: How often forced drag mode checks the keys (ms).
windowMoveArrowSequenceTimeoutHelp: Time allowed between arrow presses in one move (ms).
windowMoveNudgeIntervalHelp: Minimum time between keyboard window moves (ms).
touchForceHelp: Hold still for the selected time to make the following touch drag move the window.
touchHoldHelp: Hold time, in milliseconds (ms), before forced window-drag mode activates for touch input.
forceWindowKeyHelp: Click Record and press a key. Left and right modifier keys are distinguished. If the side is unknown, the left key is used. Hold this key when starting a drag to move the window.
forceNonWindowKeyHelp: Click Record and press a key. Left and right modifier keys are distinguished. If the side is unknown, the left key is used. Hold this key when starting a drag to drag the item normally.
dragModeSwitcherShortcutHelp: Default: Left Ctrl + Left Alt + W. Press to cycle the override: off → move-window → element-drag → off. Recording keeps left/right modifiers distinct. An unknown side defaults to left.
modeSoundHelp: Play a tone when forced mode changes.
moveModifierHelp: Click Record and press Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or a Windows key. Left and right sides are distinguished. If the side is unknown, the left key is used. Hold it with an arrow key to move the active window. Keys already used by another setting are rejected.
moveStepHelp: Base movement distance, in pixels. Tap an arrow repeatedly, then hold it to accelerate up to 10 times.
anchorHoldHelp: Hold duration, in milliseconds (ms), before keeping a drop target anchored.
graceHelp: Time, in milliseconds (ms), that a target stays anchored after fingers lift.
pollingHelp: Time in milliseconds (ms) between cursor position updates.
showIndicatorHelp: Show an indicator when drag mode changes.
indicatorDetailsHelp: Include mode information in the indicator.
indicatorDiameterHelp: Diameter of the indicator circle, in pixels.
indicatorTimeHelp: How long the indicator remains visible.
windowDragColorHelp: Color used when the gesture moves a window.
otherDragColorHelp: Color used when the gesture drags an element.
panelTextColorHelp: Text color used in indicator details.
showColorRectHelp: Display the area used for color detection.
uniformSampleColorHelp: Border color when the sampled pixels match.
mixedSampleColorHelp: Border color when the sampled pixels differ.
colorConflict: That color is already used for {0}. Choose another color.
colorRectTimeHelp: How long the detection rectangle remains visible.
clickLockEnabledHelp: Turns Windows ClickLock on or off. This setting is read from and written to Windows.
clickLockTimeHelp: Time the mouse button must be held before it stays locked. Range: 200–2200 ms. Stored by Windows.
confirmExit: Close Settings and shut down the application?
enableStylusHelp: Enable optional pen gestures. Ordinary pen input remains handled by Windows.
stylusHoldForceWindowHelp: Hold the pen tip still for the global hold duration, then move it to force a window drag.
captureModifierPrompt: Press Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Windows key…
bindingConflict: This key overlaps with “{0}”. Choose a different key or clear the other setting first.
holdIndicatorHelp: Show an indicator when touch, mouse, or stylus hold activates window drag mode.
touchIndicatorDurationHelp: How long the touch-hold indicator remains visible.
fallbackWindowDragColorHelp: Color used when a window is moved by forced window mode, using set window position.
touchHoldColorHelp: Color used when touch hold forces a window drag.
